# Part A: KNN vs lasso logistic regression

##three relevant and three irrelevant predictors

```{r}
library(readr)
data_set <- read_csv("Data.csv")
train <- data_set[1:5000, ]
test <- data_set[5001:10000, ]
```

```{r}
library(caret)
# Original analysis used a different seed, so exact numbers may differ slightly
set.seed(123)
train_new = train[,c("Y","X1","X2","X3","X4","X5","X6")]
test_new = test[,c("Y","X1","X2","X3","X4","X5","X6")]
train_new$Y = as.factor(train_new$Y)
test_new$Y = as.factor(test_new$Y)
train_control =trainControl(method ="cv", number= 10)
k_knn = seq(1,20,2)
knn_model = train(Y~ X1+X2+X3+X4+X5+X6,data =train_new,method= "knn", tuneGrid= data.frame(k = k_knn),trControl =train_control,preProcess= c("center","scale"))
print(knn_model$bestTune)
print(knn_model$results)
```

```{r}
cf <- confusionMatrix(predict(knn_model, newdata = test_new), test_new$Y)
cf
```

Lasso logistic regression

```{r}
library(glmnet)
x = model.matrix(Y ~ X1+X2+X3+X4+X5+X6, data = train_new)
y = train_new$Y
x_test <- model.matrix(Y ~ X1+X2+X3+X4+X5+X6, data = test_new)
y_test <- test_new$Y
set.seed(42)
lasso_mod <- cv.glmnet(x = x, y = y, alpha = 1, family = "binomial",nfolds = 10)
lasso_mod$lambda.min
lasso_pred = predict(lasso_mod, newx = x_test,s = "lambda.min", type = "response")
lasso_lr_class = ifelse(lasso_pred > 0.5, 1, 0)
accuracy = mean(lasso_lr_class== y_test)
accuracy
```

##all predictors

```{r}
set.seed(123)
train$Y = as.factor(train$Y)
test$Y = as.factor(test$Y)
train_control <-trainControl(method ="cv", number= 10)
k_knn = seq(1,20,2)
knn_model_full <-train(Y~.,data =train,method= "knn", tuneGrid= data.frame(k = k_knn),trControl =train_control,preProcess= c("center","scale"))
print(knn_model_full$bestTune)
print(knn_model_full$results)
```

```{r}
cf_full <- confusionMatrix(predict(knn_model_full, newdata = test), test$Y)
cf_full
```

Lasso logistic regression

```{r}
x <- model.matrix(Y ~ ., data = train)
y <- train$Y
x_test <- model.matrix(Y ~ ., data = test)
y_test <- test$Y
set.seed(42)
lasso_mod <- cv.glmnet(x = x, y = y, alpha = 1, family = "binomial",nfolds = 10)
lasso_mod$lambda.min
lasso_pred = predict(lasso_mod, newx = x_test,s = "lambda.min", type = "response")
lasso_lr_class = ifelse(lasso_pred > 0.5, 1, 0)
accuracy = mean(lasso_lr_class== y_test)
accuracy
```

#Elastic net vs GAM

```{r}
MH_data <- read.table("MHpredict.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE)
```

```{r}
summary(MH_data)
```

```{r}
hist(MH_data$dep_sev_fu,breaks = 15)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
n = nrow(MH_data)
indexB = sample(1:n, size = 500)
test_B = MH_data[indexB, ]
train_B = MH_data[-indexB,]
```

Elastic net

```{r}
library(glmnet)
set.seed(123)
xb = model.matrix(dep_sev_fu ~ .-1,train_B)
x_testb = model.matrix(dep_sev_fu ~.-1,test_B)
yb = train_B$dep_sev_fu
elastic_model = cv.glmnet(x = xb,y = yb,alpha = 0.5)
elastic_model
plot(elastic_model)
```

```{r}
cors <- cor(xb)
diag(cors) <- NA
hist(cors, main = "Observed correlations", cex.lab = .7, cex.axis = .7,
     cex.main = .7)
```

```{r}
elastic_model$lambda.min
```

```{r}
elastic_coefs <- coef(elastic_model, s = "lambda.min")
elastic_coefs[elastic_coefs[ , 1] != 0, ]
```

```{r}
coef(elastic_model, s = "lambda.min")
```

```{r}
e_preds <- predict(elastic_model, s = "lambda.min", newx = x_testb)
MSE = mean((e_preds - test_B$dep_sev_fu)^2)
MSE
```

```{r}
MSE_max=var(test_B$dep_sev_fu)
R2 = 1 - MSE/MSE_max
R2
```

GAM

```{r}
library(mgcv)
```

```{r}
plot(MH_data[ , c("Age", "aedu", "IDS", "BAI","FQ","LCImax","AO")])
```

```{r}
gam_model = gam(dep_sev_fu~s(Age)+aedu+s(IDS)+s(BAI)+s(FQ)+s(LCImax)+s(AO)+Sexe+pedigree+alcohol+bTypeDep+bSocPhob+bGAD+bPanic +bAgo +RemDis+ sample+ ADuse +PsychTreat
, data = train_B)
```

```{r}
summary(gam_model)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(gam_model, residuals = TRUE)
```

```{r}
pred = predict(gam_model, newdata = test_B,type = "response")
MSEg = mean((pred - test_B$dep_sev_fu)^2)
MSEg

yvar = var(test_B$dep_sev_fu)
R2g = 1 - (MSEg/yvar)
R2g
```

```{r}
gam.check(gam_model)
```
